evidence.zh: "ALEXANDRA": 啊，你们在这儿！刚才不好意思啦。

evidence.en: "ALEXANDRA": I think it's this way.
evidence.zh: "ALEXANDRA": 应该走这边。

evidence.en: COLONEL: What, did Boenicke send you to take notes?
evidence.zh: COLONEL: 怎么，伯尼克派你来做记录？

evidence.en: COLONEL: Well, that's everyone, then.
evidence.zh: COLONEL: 好，人齐了。

evidence.zh: CONDUCTOR: 请各位上车！

evidence.en: CONDUCTOR: Next departure won't be for a while.
evidence.zh: CONDUCTOR: 下一班还得等一会儿。

evidence.en: ARCHAEOLOGIST: I came here in search of a famous heirloom sword. Its last known owner was stationed at this monastery, during the war against Corsin.
evidence.zh: ARCHAEOLOGIST: 我是来找一柄有名的传世宝剑的。它最后一位有记载的主人，在对抗科尔辛的战争中，曾驻扎于这座修道院。

evidence.en: CORDELIA: He is one of the four sages who defeated General Corsin on the top of Mt. Nibaros, at the end of the Great War.
evidence.zh: CORDELIA: 大战结束时，在尼巴罗斯山顶击败科尔辛将军的四位贤者，他便是其中之一。

evidence.en: HEIZER: You can't seriously believe that. Look at what Corsin achieved, in this war.
evidence.zh: HEIZER: 你不会真这么想吧？看看科尔辛在这场战争中做成了什么。

evidence.en: OLD WOMAN: Dimitri's restaurant went up with a bang. Probably for the insurance money.
evidence.zh: OLD WOMAN: 迪米特里的餐馆轰的一声就没了。八成是为了骗保险。

evidence.en: OLD WOMAN: Nobody's bought Dimitri's old place. I guess they're superstitious.
evidence.zh: OLD WOMAN: 迪米特里那块地方还没人买。估计都嫌晦气。

evidence.en: MAN: Hey, you are... were the cook over at Dimitri's right?
evidence.zh: MAN: 嘿，你是……以前在迪米特里那儿当厨师的吧？

evidence.en: CORDELIA: Whoever Gustav Heizer was, he must have believed in them. It would not have been unusual for his place and time.
evidence.zh: CORDELIA: 古斯塔夫·海泽无论是什么人，一定相信这些。在他的时代与故乡，这并不奇怪。

evidence.en: HAELAN: I suspected that, like me, Gustav Heizer must still be alive, after all these years.
evidence.zh: HAELAN: 我曾怀疑，这么多年过去，古斯塔夫·海泽一定也和我一样，依然活着。

evidence.en: JEROME: Gustav Heizer must have spent almost 150 years on a quest for power. Or else, what was he doing, all that time?
evidence.zh: JEROME: 古斯塔夫·海泽想必用了近一百五十年追求力量。不然，那些年他都在做什么？

evidence.en: LECLAIRE: Are you related to Dr. Joseph Helmont, by any chance?
evidence.zh: LECLAIRE: 请问，您与约瑟夫·赫尔蒙特医生有亲属关系吗？

evidence.en: "And yet, we find that even ardent skeptics like Girardeau, Le Dernier[oxfordComma /] and Nelli talked about magic as though it were an everyday fact of life.
evidence.zh: “然而我们发现，就连吉拉尔多、勒德尼耶[oxfordComma /]和内利这些坚定的怀疑论者，谈起魔法时，也将它视为日常生活中理所当然的事实。

evidence.en: "And yet, we find that even ardent skeptics like Girardeau, Le Dernier[oxfordComma /] and Nelli talked about magic as though it were an everyday fact of life.
evidence.zh: “然而我们发现，就连吉拉尔多、勒德尼耶[oxfordComma /]和内利这些坚定的怀疑论者，谈起魔法时，也将它视为日常生活中理所当然的事实。

evidence.en: <align="center">I journeyed to Seren, to find Pierre Le Dernier, in the hope that he could explain what had happened.</align>
evidence.zh: <align="center">我前往塞伦，寻找皮埃尔·勒德尼耶，希望他能解释发生的一切。</align>

evidence.en: BEN: Hey Lydia, is the boss in back?
evidence.zh: BEN: 嘿，莉迪娅，老板在后面吗？

evidence.en: KID: Hey Ben, you better get over there. It's almost your shift. Paulos will be mad.
evidence.zh: KID: 嘿，本，快过去吧。快轮到你干活了，保洛斯会生气的。

evidence.en: BEN: Hey, Paulos. How come I never see you cleaning one of these things?
evidence.zh: BEN: 嘿，保洛斯，怎么从没见你洗过这东西？

evidence.en: BEN: C'mon, Paulos, everybody knows Uncle Vlad likes you the best.
evidence.zh: BEN: 得了吧，保洛斯，谁不知道弗拉德叔叔最喜欢你。

evidence.en: ????: What are you doing in my woods, Phylaka?
evidence.zh: ????: 守护者，你来我的树林做什么？

evidence.en: ????: (Wait, she's a phylaka?)
evidence.zh: ????: （等等，她是守护者？）

evidence.en: PACHIS: That phylaka? You know, not a lot of people scare me. But she did.
evidence.zh: PACHIS: 那个守护者？老兄，能吓着我的人没几个。她算一个。

evidence.en: <align="center">I journeyed to Seren, to find Pierre Le Dernier, in the hope that he could explain what had happened.</align>
evidence.zh: <align="center">我前往塞伦，寻找皮埃尔·勒德尼耶，希望他能解释发生的一切。</align>

evidence.en: KERAUNOS: My friend, Pierre, lived near this square.
evidence.zh: KERAUNOS: 我的朋友皮埃尔，就住在这片广场附近。

evidence.en: KERAUNOS: I am looking for my friend, a scholar of magic. Pierre Le Dernier.
evidence.zh: KERAUNOS: 我在找一位研究魔法的朋友，皮埃尔·勒德尼耶。

evidence.en: RA'WLOS: Hear the wisdom of Ra'wlos T. Wise!
evidence.zh: RA'WLOS: 来听听智者拉沃洛斯的智慧！

evidence.en: PAULOS: Ben! Get over here and finish cleaning Yonni's still!
evidence.zh: PAULOS: 本！过来把约尼那台蒸馏器洗完！

evidence.en: KID: Yonni's really sick.
evidence.zh: KID: 约尼病得很厉害。

evidence.en: KASSANDRA: Yonni? Can you look at me for a sec? I'm gonna take your sickness away.
evidence.zh: KASSANDRA: 约尼？看着我，好吗？我来把你的病移走。
